args.text:
Fixed-limit hold'em strategy (A03):
1. Play tight-aggressive. Enter with strong hands (pairs, AK/AQ/AJ suited, broadway, suited connectors in late position).
2. Fold weak hands out of position facing a raise; don't limp junk.
3. Bet/raise strong made hands and strong draws for value; in fixed limit, aggression usually beats passive calling.
4. Call down with medium-strength hands only when pot odds justify it; fold to heavy multi-way action without a strong hand.
5. Watch opponents: note who bluffs, who folds to pressure, who always calls. Adjust: bluff more against tight folders, value-bet thinner against calling stations.
6. Avoid bluffing into multiple opponents.
Update notes after each game on opponent tendencies and rule results.
